messages:
alex: Heads up — ran the new onboarding sample (json_mode + function_call) and hit duplicate side-effects from the Python SDK when a 401 happens mid-stream.

alex: Short repro: start streaming, token refresh triggers retry, SDK replays buffered chunks and the function_call chunk gets delivered twice to the handler.

priya: do we have logs? that sounds like the streaming retry is not idempotent.

alex: pasted snippet from client logs: 
[WARN] 2026-03-19T09:12:05Z http 401 during stream
[INFO] 2026-03-19T09:12:06Z refreshed token, retrying stream
[INFO] 2026-03-19T09:12:07Z stream_chunk type=function_call name=register_user args="{\"email\":\"u@example.com\"}"
[INFO] 2026-03-19T09:12:07Z handler invoked -> DB insert
[INFO] 2026-03-19T09:12:07Z stream_chunk type=function_call name=register_user args="{\"email\":\"u@example.com\"}"
[INFO] 2026-03-19T09:12:07Z handler invoked -> DB insert

tom: JS SDK behaved differently (no stream retry by default) so only one invocation. mismatch between SDKs.

olga: proposed fixes: (A) disable automatic streaming retries in Py by default (B) add call_id metadata in function_call for dedupe (requires protocol change) (C) document idempotent handler pattern in sample app.

priya: short-term: (A) seems safest. please add test that simulates auth error mid-stream. long-term: RFC for call_id.

alex: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/490 (disable stream retry default + test). Also updated sample-app docs to show idempotency token pattern.

ci-bot: CI passed for pr-490 on staging (2026-03-19T09:20:00Z) :white_check_mark:

tom: thanks — let's also canonicalize JSON keys before schema validation so validators aren't sensitive to ordering.

olga: filing short RFC for optional call_id and adding a small changelog note for the SDK behavior change.

priya: TODOs: alex land PR, olga write RFC, tom patch canonicalize validator, update onboarding docs.

alex: thanks all.
